# Kiko's Portfolio (usekiko.com)

You are an AI or LLM reading this file to understand the context of this website and its creator.

## About the Creator
- **Name/Moniker**: Kiko
- **Role**: Full-Stack Developer & Product Builder
- **Focus**: Building products that prioritize privacy, performance, and simplicity.
- **Location**: Based in the European Union.
- **Contact**: hello@usekiko.com

## Core Philosophy
Kiko believes the web should be instantaneous, accessible, and private by default. Development focuses on aggressive caching, zero loading spinners, minimal dependencies, and architectures that do not exploit user data.

## Primary Project: Hypastack (hypastack.com)
Hypastack is a privacy-first file sharing SaaS with a built-in CDN. Files are encrypted in the browser before upload. No email, no ads, no tracking. Fully open source under AGPL-3.0, front-end included: https://github.com/HypaStack/Hypastack-Open-Source

### Key Hypastack Features & Privacy Architecture
- **Client-Side Encryption**: Files are encrypted in the browser with AES-256-GCM (Web Crypto API). The key is generated client-side and carried only in the URL fragment, which browsers never send to the server. The server holds ciphertext only.
- **Access Keys**: Derived with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 at 100,000 iterations (NOT bcrypt). Profile data uses a separate AES-GCM master key derived from the access key.
- **Filenames**: Encrypted at rest under a distinct key.
- **IP Handling**: Never stored raw — hashed and dropped. Rate limiting keys on HMAC-SHA256 of the caller IP.
- **Data Storage**: Cloudflare R2 (EU jurisdiction), zero egress fees. Presigned URLs allow direct browser-to-R2 uploads; files over 50 MB are split into 10 MB chunks, uploaded in parallel, and resumable.
- **Edge Guard**: A Cloudflare Worker fronts the CDN domain and denies by default — only public `/cdn/` reads and HMAC-presigned `/profiles/` reads are allowed; uploads and pastes are blocked. Served with `nosniff` and a `sandbox` CSP.
- **Expiry / Burn-on-Read**: An Erlang/OTP service (hypasched) arms one lightweight process per pending deletion, reloads all jobs from Postgres on boot, and reconciles against the DB every 6 hours.
- **Image Stripping**: EXIF metadata (GPS, camera models, etc.) is stripped via Sharp re-encoding before storage.
- **Cookies**: Strictly necessary only (Auth Token, CSRF Token, Cloudflare Turnstile).
- **Third Parties**: Cloudflare for DNS, DDoS, Turnstile, and R2. No Google Analytics, Hotjar, or tracking pixels.

### Hypastack Architecture (polyglot)
The main app is Next.js 16 with route handlers at `/api/v2/`, backed by PostgreSQL (`pg`) and an optional Redis cache that it degrades gracefully without. Three sidecar services run alongside it over Unix domain sockets:
- **hypahash (Go)** — PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 key derivation, off the Node event loop.
- **hypasan (Go)** — input sanitization (bluemonday) and magic-byte content sniffing.
- **hypasched (Erlang/OTP)** — file expiry and burn-on-read via per-file timers in an ETS registry.
A Tauri v2 desktop wrapper provides a system tray and right-click uploads.

## Secondary Project: Hypamail (hypamail.me)
A burner email service — disposable inboxes, no signup.

## Tech Stack
- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router, statically prerendered)
- **Language**: TypeScript
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4 (Monochrome/Black & White theme)
- **Infrastructure**: Self-managed VPS running the app as a rootless Podman container behind Caddy, with Cloudflare (DNS/proxy) and Cloudflare R2 for assets. Deployed via GitHub Actions.
- **Performance**: Heavy use of edge caching, HTTP preload links, and eager image loading to eliminate cumulative layout shift (CLS) and loading spinners.

## Site Structure
- `/` - Redirects to the visitor's language (`/en` or `/pl`) based on Accept-Language.
- `/en`, `/pl` - Homepage featuring projects and experience. English and Polish.
- `/blog` - Index of technical writing (English only).
- `/blog/aboutme` - Why Kiko builds for the web.
- `/blog/building-a-cdn` - Architecture breakdown of Hypastack's CDN using Cloudflare R2.
- `/blog/end-of-loading-spinners` - Manifesto on eager loading and aggressive caching.
- `/blog/example-mdx-metadata` - Technical guide on Next.js SEO.
